notes: Moonlit is now Axis, with the new star logo. This update replaces the old Moonlit app; your sign-in, settings and downloads are kept. New: Live TV from your Jellyfin server (On Now, a Guide timeline, bookmarks and an On Now row on Home), a redesigned Settings with search and Graphite / Slate / Pure Black backgrounds, a Library banner, Versions on film pages, and removing a show from Continue Watching. Show pages now fill in missing episodes, titles and pictures, and films that aren't out yet say so.
